name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          # Refresh PATH to include chocolatey-installed binaries
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "User") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $redisServer = Get-Command redis-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if (-not $redisServer) {
            # Fallback: search common install locations
            $found = Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\ProgramData\chocolatey" -Recurse -Filter "redis-server.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($found) {
              $env:PATH = "$($found.DirectoryName);$env:PATH"
            } else {
              throw "redis-server.exe not found after installation"
            }
          }
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

content.text: Now commit and push.

input.command:
git add .github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): start Vite preview server for Tauri debug builds

Debug builds use devUrl (http://localhost:1420) instead of embedding
frontendDist. Without a dev server, the webview loads an empty page
and JS auth flow never executes.

Fix: Start `vite preview --port 1420` before launching the desktop
binary on all platforms. This serves the pre-built frontend bundle.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

---
status: fixing
trigger: "Desktop E2E tests fail on all three platforms in CI"
created: 2026-03-01T04:00:00Z
updated: 2026-03-01T05:05:00Z
branch: fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3
---

## Current Focus

hypothesis: Debug binary uses devUrl (http://localhost:1420) not embedded frontendDist
test: Start `vite preview --port 1420` before binary launch on all platforms
expecting: Webview loads real frontend, JS auth flow runs, mount appears
next_action: Analyze CI run results
ci_run: pending (just triggered round 4)

## Symptoms

expected: All desktop E2E tests pass on macOS, Linux, and Windows in CI
actual: All three platforms fail — binary starts, webview created, but mount never appears
reproduction: workflow_dispatch on fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3

## Timeline

### Round 1 — CI run 22535471201 (main branch)
- Windows: Kubo download fails (PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest IOException)
- macOS: dyld error — Library not loaded: @rpath/libfuse-t.dylib
- Linux: Mount not detected after 90s

### Round 2 — CI run 22536010865 (fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3, commit 10deba393)
Applied fixes: frontend build before cargo, rpath fix, bash+curl for Kubo, WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER
- ✅ macOS: rpath FIXED, binary starts without crash
- ✅ Kubo download FIXED on all platforms
- ❌ macOS+Linux: Binary starts, webview created, but mount never appears (no Rust log after setup)
- ❌ Windows: redis-server not found after choco install (PATH not refreshed)

### Round 3 — CI run 22536256440 (commit 5d3ce6e26)
Applied fixes: diagnostic logging (on_page_load, get_dev_key logging, RUST_LOG=debug, pre-flight checks, Redis PATH fix)
- 🔍 **SMOKING GUN FOUND**: Webview page load logged `url=http://localhost:1420/`
  - Debug builds use `devUrl` not `frontendDist`!
  - No Vite dev server running → empty page → JS never runs → no auth → no mount
- `get_dev_key` never called (confirms JS not executing)
- Pre-flight: API health check passed

### Round 4 — CI run pending (commit a236637e7)
Applied fix: Start `vite preview --port 1420` before binary launch on all platforms
- Uses pre-built dist from earlier Vite build step
- Serves on port 1420 (what debug binary's devUrl expects)
- Also fixed Windows Redis PATH refresh

## Eliminated

- hypothesis: xvfb-action splitting commands
  evidence: Fixed in earlier commits (dbc4e3d44), replaced with manual Xvfb

- hypothesis: Missing rpath for FUSE-T dylib (macOS)
  evidence: FIXED. install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib works. CI logs show LC_RPATH.

- hypothesis: PowerShell Kubo download unreliable (Windows)
  evidence: FIXED. bash+curl with --retry works reliably.

- hypothesis: Missing frontend build
  evidence: PARTIALLY relevant. Frontend IS built, but debug binary doesn't embed it.
  The real issue is that debug builds use devUrl not frontendDist.

- hypothesis: WebKitGTK DMA-BUF renderer (Linux)
  evidence: Not the cause. WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 added but mount still failed.

- hypothesis: WASM import failure in auth.ts
  evidence: Not the cause (yet). Page loads `http://localhost:1420/` which returns nothing —
  JS never even has a chance to fail. If the dev server fix works but auth fails, WASM may
  become relevant.

## Root Cause (confirmed)

**Tauri debug builds use `devUrl` (http://localhost:1420), not embedded `frontendDist`.**

In `tauri.conf.json`:
```json
{
  "devUrl": "http://localhost:1420",
  "frontendDist": "../dist"
}
```

When built with `cargo build` (debug profile), Tauri generates code that makes the webview
load from `devUrl`. Only release builds or `tauri build` embed assets from `frontendDist`.

In CI, no Vite dev server was running on port 1420 → webview loaded empty page → no JS →
no auth → no mount.

**Fix:** Start `vite preview --port 1420` before the binary. This serves the pre-built
frontend (same bundle that vite build produced earlier) on the port the debug binary expects.

## Fixes Applied (all commits on fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3)

| # | Fix | Commit | Status |
|---|-----|--------|--------|
| 1 | Move Node.js/pnpm setup BEFORE cargo build | 10deba393 | ✅ |
| 2 | Add "Build desktop frontend" step | 10deba393 | ✅ |
| 3 | Add install_name_tool rpath for macOS | 10deba393 | ✅ |
| 4 | Switch Windows Kubo to bash+curl --retry | 10deba393 | ✅ |
| 5 | Add WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 (Linux) | 10deba393 | ✅ |
| 6 | Capture binary logs on failure | 10deba393 | ✅ |
| 7 | Add on_page_load webview callback | 5d3ce6e26 | ✅ (diagnostic) |
| 8 | Add logging to get_dev_key | 5d3ce6e26 | ✅ (diagnostic) |
| 9 | Fix Windows Redis PATH refresh | 5d3ce6e26 | ✅ |
| 10 | Start Vite preview server on :1420 | a236637e7 | 🔄 pending CI |

## Open Questions

1. Will `vite preview --port 1420` correctly serve the pre-built frontend?
2. Will the WASM modules in auth.ts load correctly in the webview?
3. Will the test-login API call succeed from the webview?
4. Windows: will the Redis PATH fix work with the refreshenv approach?

---
status: fixing
trigger: "Desktop E2E tests fail on all three platforms in CI"
created: 2026-03-01T04:00:00Z
updated: 2026-03-01T04:55:00Z
branch: fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3
---

## Current Focus

hypothesis: Webview JS fails silently — auth flow never triggers IPC commands
test: Added on_page_load callback, get_dev_key logging, RUST_LOG=debug, pre-flight API check
expecting: Diagnostic logs will reveal whether (a) page loads, (b) JS calls get_dev_key, (c) API is reachable
next_action: Analyze CI run 22536256440 logs when complete
ci_run: 22536256440

## Symptoms

expected: All desktop E2E tests pass on macOS, Linux, and Windows in CI
actual: All three platforms fail with different errors
errors: |
  Round 1 (run 22535471201, main branch):
    1. Windows: Kubo download fails - IOException on dist.ipfs.tech (PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest)
    2. macOS: dyld error - Library not loaded: @rpath/libfuse-t.dylib, then Abort trap: 6
    3. Linux: Mount never appears after 90s timeout

  Round 2 (run 22536010865, fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3):
    1. Windows: redis-server not found after choco install (PATH not refreshed)
    2. macOS: Binary starts OK (rpath FIXED), but mount never appears after 90s
    3. Linux: Binary starts OK, but mount never appears after 90s

    macOS+Linux show same pattern: binary starts, webview created, "setup complete", then nothing.
    No Rust logs after setup → JS never calls any Tauri IPC commands.
reproduction: workflow_dispatch on fix/desktop-e2e-ci-round3
started: CI debugging iteration

## Eliminated

- hypothesis: xvfb-action splitting commands
  evidence: Already fixed in commit dbc4e3d44, replaced with manual Xvfb
  timestamp: 2026-03-01

- hypothesis: Invoke-WebRequest for IPFS readiness check
  evidence: Already replaced with curl.exe in commit 232e7e8fe (PR #230)
  timestamp: 2026-03-01

- hypothesis: Missing rpath for FUSE-T dylib (macOS)
  evidence: FIXED in round 2. install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib works. CI logs show LC_RPATH present.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:40:00Z

- hypothesis: Missing frontend build
  evidence: PARTIALLY FIXED. Frontend now builds before cargo build. But binary still doesn't mount.
  The frontend IS built (dist/ created), but the JS inside the webview may not execute properly.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:40:00Z

- hypothesis: PowerShell Kubo download unreliable
  evidence: FIXED in round 2. Switched to bash+curl with --retry. Kubo downloaded successfully.
  timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:44:00Z

## Evidence

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:40:00Z
  checked: CI run 22536010865 macOS job
  found: |
    LC_RPATH present (/usr/local/lib) — rpath fix works.
    Binary starts: "CipherBox Desktop starting...", "dev-key provided", "System tray icon created",
    "Dev-key mode: auto-creating login webview", "CipherBox Desktop setup complete".
    Then NOTHING for 90s. No Rust log output from get_dev_key or handle_test_login_complete.
  implication: JS in webview never calls Tauri IPC. Either page doesn't load, or JS fails at module init.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:41:00Z
  checked: CI run 22536010865 Linux job
  found: Same pattern as macOS. Binary starts, webview created, setup complete, then silence.
  implication: Cross-platform issue — not platform-specific.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:44:00Z
  checked: CI run 22536010865 Windows job
  found: redis-server not found after "choco install redis-64 -y". PATH not refreshed.
  implication: Need to refresh PATH or find redis-server.exe explicitly.

- timestamp: 2026-03-01T04:50:00Z
  checked: Frontend code analysis
  found: |
    main.ts imports from ./auth which imports @toruslabs/tss-dkls-lib (WASM-based).
    If WASM module evaluation fails, entire main.ts fails to load, init() never runs.
    No WASM files in dist/ — WASM may be inlined in JS bundle or loaded dynamically.
    Webview console output is invisible (not forwarded to stdout).
  implication: Most likely JS module evaluation failure. Need diagnostic logging.

## Fixes Applied

### Round 2 (commit 10deba393)
1. ✅ Move Node.js/pnpm setup BEFORE cargo build
2. ✅ Add "Build desktop frontend" step (crypto build + vite build with VITE env vars)
3. ✅ Add install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib for macOS
4. ✅ Switch Windows Kubo install to bash+curl with --retry
5. ✅ Add WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER=1 for Linux
6. ✅ Add diagnostic binary log capture on failure

### Round 3 (commit 5d3ce6e26)
7. ✅ Add on_page_load callback to webview for page load logging
8. ✅ Add logging to get_dev_key Rust command
9. ✅ Set RUST_LOG=debug for verbose output
10. ✅ Add pre-flight API health check
11. ✅ Add dist/ directory listing for verification
12. ✅ Fix Windows Redis PATH refresh after choco install

## Open Questions

1. Does the webview page actually load? (on_page_load will tell us)
2. Does JS call get_dev_key? (Rust logging will tell us)
3. Does the auth module WASM import fail? (need webview console forwarding)
4. Is the API test-login endpoint reachable from the webview? (pre-flight check will tell us)

not embedded frontendDist. Webview was loading empty page.

)"

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          # Refresh PATH to include chocolatey-installed binaries
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "User") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $redisServer = Get-Command redis-server -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if (-not $redisServer) {
            # Fallback: search common install locations
            $found = Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\ProgramData\chocolatey" -Recurse -Filter "redis-server.exe" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
            if ($found) {
              $env:PATH = "$($found.DirectoryName);$env:PATH"
            } else {
              throw "redis-server.exe not found after installation"
            }
          }
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
            /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log
          retention-days: 7

lines: -          # Refresh PATH to include chocolatey-installed binaries
+          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
+          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

input.command:
git add .github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(ci): use memurai-developer directly for Windows Redis

The redis-64 choco package installs Memurai as its backend but
redis-server.exe doesn't exist. Install memurai-developer directly
which runs as a Windows service.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push

Perfect! Now I have all the information needed. Let me compile a comprehensive report.

## CORS Configuration in CipherBox API

### 1. **Location of CORS Configuration**

CORS is configured in **`apps/api/src/main.ts`** (lines 29-50). There is no separate middleware file — it's set up directly in the NestJS bootstrap function using `app.enableCors()`.

### 2. **What Origins Are Allowed**

The CORS configuration uses a multi-layered approach:

**Default origins** (if `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` env var is not set):
- `http://localhost:5173` (Vite dev server for web app)
- `http://localhost:4173` (Vite preview server for web app)

**From environment variable `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`**:
- Parsed as a comma-separated list: `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=origin1,origin2,origin3`
- Each entry is trimmed of whitespace
- **Supports wildcard patterns** using `*` (e.g., `https://cipher-box-pr-*.onrender.com`)

### 3. **How `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` Is Used**

From `/apps/api/src/main.ts` (lines 30-37):

```typescript
const rawOrigins = process.env.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS;
const originEntries = rawOrigins
  ? rawOrigins.split(',').map((s) => s.trim())
  : ['http://localhost:5173', 'http://localhost:4173'];
const exactOrigins = originEntries.filter((o) => !o.includes('*'));
const wildcardPatterns = originEntries
  .filter((o) => o.includes('*'))
  .map((o) => new RegExp(`^${o.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\*/g, '.*')}$`));
```

The logic:
1. **Exact matches**: Origins without wildcards are stored as-is in `exactOrigins` array
2. **Wildcard patterns**: Origins containing `*` are converted to RegExp patterns for prefix/suffix matching
3. The origin callback (lines 40-48) checks:
   - If no origin header: allow (line 44)
   - If exact match in `exactOrigins`: allow (line 45)
   - If matches any wildcard RegExp: allow (line 46)
   - Otherwise: reject with "Origin {origin} not allowed by CORS" error (line 47)

**Credentials are enabled**: `credentials: true` (line 49), meaning cookies are sent with CORS requests.

### 4. **Will `http://localhost:1420` Be Blocked?**

**YES, it will be blocked.**

The desktop app uses port **1420** as its dev server port (from `apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` line 7: `"devUrl": "http://localhost:1420"`). 

However, the default CORS allowed origins are:
- `http://localhost:5173` (web app dev)
- `http://localhost:4173` (web app preview)

file.content:
name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    # Skip change detection for workflow_dispatch (always run)
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/e2e-desktop.yml'

  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: [changes]
    if: >-
      always() && !cancelled() &&
      (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        (
          github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
          needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
        )
      )
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || '' }}

      # --- Install FUSE driver (needed for both build and test) ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          FUSE_T_PC="/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc"
          if [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            FUSE_T_PC=$(find /Library /usr/local /opt/homebrew -name "fuse-t.pc" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
          fi
          if [ -z "$FUSE_T_PC" ] || [ ! -f "$FUSE_T_PC" ]; then
            echo "::error::fuse-t.pc not found after FUSE-T installation"
            exit 1
          fi
          sudo cp "$FUSE_T_PC" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc
          sudo sed -i '' 's/^Version:.*/Version: 2.9.9/' /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install system dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            fuse3 \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm (needed for frontend build before cargo) ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      # --- Build desktop frontend (Tauri embeds from frontendDist) ---

      - name: Build desktop frontend
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite build
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      # --- Build debug binary ---

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ matrix.platform }}-cargo-

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Build debug binary
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features ${{ matrix.fuse-feature }}
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Fix rpath for FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: install_name_tool -add_rpath /usr/local/lib apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }} || true

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install kubo
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_linux-amd64.tar.gz" | tar -xz
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 \
            "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_windows-amd64.zip" \
            -o kubo.zip
          unzip -q kubo.zip
          echo "$PWD/kubo" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          export PATH="$PWD/kubo:$PATH"
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install memurai-developer -y --no-progress
          # Memurai installs as a Windows service and starts automatically
          $svc = Get-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          if ($svc -and $svc.Status -eq "Running") {
            Write-Host "Memurai service is running"
          } else {
            # Fallback: start service manually
            Start-Service -Name "Memurai" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
          }
          # Verify Redis is responding
          $env:PATH = [System.Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "Machine") + ";" + $env:PATH
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) {
            try {
              $result = & redis-cli ping 2>$null
              if ($result -eq "PONG") { $ready = $true; break }
            } catch {}
            Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
          }
          if ($ready) { Write-Host "Redis (Memurai) ready" } else { Write-Host "WARNING: Redis may not be ready" }

      # --- Build backend packages ---

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build API
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Start frontend dev server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          pnpm vite preview --port 1420 &
          # Wait for dev server
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:1420 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Frontend dev server ready on :1420"
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
        env:
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        env:
          CIPHERBOX_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_API_URL: http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          RUST_LOG: info
          DISPLAY: ':99'
          WEBKIT_DISABLE_DMABUF_RENDERER: '1'
        run: |
          Xvfb :99 -screen 0 1024x768x24 &
          sleep 1
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY > /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>&1 &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "=== Desktop binary log ==="
            cat /tmp/cipherbox-desktop.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no log file)"
          fi
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Start frontend dev server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd apps/desktop
          npx vite preview --port 1420 &
          for i in $(seq 1 15); do

  initCoreKit,
  getCoreKitStatus,
  restoreSession,

} from './auth';
